recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-19575 unless a future work-group decision changes how non-server FHIR conformance assertions should be documented.
issue_request: FHIR-19575 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked whether a conformance/capability statement is required for FHIR conformance. The accepted clarification was that non-server systems may publish a CapabilityStatement to assert formal conformance, and that conformance assertions without a CapabilityStatement have little meaning because they cannot be tested or verified.
initial_application: Git commit 8c2e1da030578313093b7b0267c6e9953e257156 applied the issue on 2022-08-25 by extending source/conformance-rules.html to cover RESTful server CapabilityStatement publication and optional CapabilityStatement publication by other systems or applications asserting formal conformance.
additional_context: source/conformance-rules.html is active build-scope narrative, listed in source/hierarchy.xml and linked from source/conformance-module.html and source/documentation.html. The current text uses 'Other systems or applications' instead of the Jira resolution's 'Non-server systems', but preserves the same implementer-facing rule. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later FHIR-core decision or community discussion that changes this conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the requested CapabilityStatement conformance language is already present and semantically aligned with the approved resolution.
